height_reference: PL-KRON86-NH, from preserved product metadata; not inferred from the LAS header
core_selection: Accepted, lower return group and XY radius <=0.75 m; no surface class assumed.

proposal.meaning: Conditional estimate of the interpreted rim surface at the adopted XY, not a located survey mark or measured threshold.
limits: Fit residuals, input centimetre quantization and recording step are not absolute accuracy.
The XY pick region is not surveyed; shifting the interpreted point can change height materially.
All six rim returns are class 0 (unclassified); their coherent geometry supports a rim interpretation, not material identification.
A larger generic plane blends rim, shaft wall/floor and neighbouring slope; class 2 can select a much higher overlapping surface.
Three source IDs/scan groups support the small patch, but source IDs are not globally unique acquisition identifiers.
The target is inside the six-point XY hull; some leave-out tests extrapolate and shift the estimate.
The station mark has not been recognized in imagery or ALS; no field-survey accuracy is claimed.
